title: Hom-colimit comparison for a fixed distinguished cone
statement: In Situation 05S8 [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization], let F:C -> D be exact and T a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Let LX and LY be supplied left-derived values at the first two vertices, with natural cones uX and uY and their retraction/common-stage certificates [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram]. Let (LX,LY,K,lf,b,c) be a fixed distinguished triangle. Suppose denominators sX and sY, a lifted first map fprime with sX followed by T.mor1 equal to fprime followed by sY, and retractions alpha:F(sX.source) -> LX and beta:F(sY.source) -> LY are supplied. Suppose uX(sX) followed by alpha and uY(sY) followed by beta are identities, and F(fprime) followed by beta equals alpha followed by lf. Then there are a denominator sZ into T.obj3, a map gprime:sY.source -> sZ.source, and r:F(sZ.source) -> K, such that sY followed by T.mor2 equals gprime followed by sZ, F(gprime) followed by r equals beta followed by b, and for every W in D the map Hom(K,W) -> colim over (S/T.obj3)^op of Hom(F(Zprime),W), sending phi to the class of r followed by phi at sZ, is bijective. No third derived value is assumed or asserted.

The supplied equation F(fprime) followed by beta equals alpha followed by lf is the first square of a triangle morphism to the fixed distinguished cone (LX,LY,K). TR3 extends it by r, retaining the second-square equation F(gprime) followed by r equals beta followed by b.

Return its third denominator, gprime, r, the denominator second-square equation and the retained retraction second-square equation, together with the Hom-colimit bijections.

theorem leftDerived_fixedCone_homColimit
    {C : Type u} {D : Type uD} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    [CategoryTheory.IsTriangulated C]
    [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ] [Preadditive D]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive] [Pretriangulated D]
    [CategoryTheory.IsTriangulated D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (S : MorphismProperty C)
    (hS : S.IsSaturatedTriangulatedMultiplicativeSystem)
    (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (LX LY : D)
    (hX : F.IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedValue S hS T.obj₁ LX)
    (hY : F.IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedValue S hS T.obj₂ LY)
    (uX : (Functor.const (S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁)).obj LX ⟶
      MorphismProperty.Over.forget S ⊤ T.obj₁ ⋙ Over.forget T.obj₁ ⋙ F)
    (uY : (Functor.const (S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂)).obj LY ⟶
      MorphismProperty.Over.forget S ⊤ T.obj₂ ⋙ Over.forget T.obj₂ ⋙ F)
    (huX : ∃ s₀ : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁, ∃ r : F.obj s₀.left ⟶ LX,
      uX.app s₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 LX ∧
        ∀ s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁, ∃ t : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁,
          ∃ a : t ⟶ s₀, ∃ b : t ⟶ s,
            F.map b.left = F.map a.left ≫ r ≫ uX.app s)
    (huY : ∃ s₀ : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂, ∃ r : F.obj s₀.left ⟶ LY,
      uY.app s₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 LY ∧
        ∀ s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂, ∃ t : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂,
          ∃ a : t ⟶ s₀, ∃ b : t ⟶ s,
            F.map b.left = F.map a.left ≫ r ≫ uY.app s)
    (lf : LX ⟶ LY) (K : D) (b : LY ⟶ K)
    (c : K ⟶ (shiftFunctor D (1 : ℤ)).obj LX)
    (hK : Triangle.mk lf b c ∈ distTriang D)
    (sX : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁) (sY : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂)
    (f' : sX.left ⟶ sY.left)
    (hsq : sX.hom ≫ T.mor₁ = f' ≫ sY.hom)
    (alpha : F.obj sX.left ⟶ LX) (beta : F.obj sY.left ⟶ LY)
    (halpha : uX.app sX ≫ alpha = 𝟙 LX)
    (hbeta : uY.app sY ≫ beta = 𝟙 LY)
    (hret : F.map f' ≫ beta = alpha ≫ lf) :
    ∃ (sZ : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃) (g' : sY.left ⟶ sZ.left)
      (r : F.obj sZ.left ⟶ K),
      sY.hom ≫ T.mor₂ = g' ≫ sZ.hom ∧
      F.map g' ≫ r = beta ≫ b ∧
      ∀ W : D, Function.Bijective (fun phi : K ⟶ W ↦
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.forget S ⊤ T.obj₃ ⋙ Over.forget T.obj₃ ⋙ F).op ⋙
          yoneda.obj W).ιColimitType (Opposite.op sZ) (r ≫ phi))
